findings.description: The configuration explicitly marks this bucket as public ('bucket is public') with no access control restricting it, and it stores customer-master.xlsx (customer PII) via aws_s3_bucket_object.data_object. Any unauthenticated user can read the customer data stored in this bucket.
This bucket is documented as not encrypted and has no server_side_encryption_configuration, so the customer master data (customer-master.xlsx) stored in it is written to S3 in cleartext.
This bucket is documented as not encrypted and has no server_side_encryption_configuration, leaving financial data stored at rest in cleartext.
This bucket is documented as not encrypted and has no server_side_encryption_configuration, leaving operations data stored at rest in cleartext.
This bucket is documented as not encrypted and has no server_side_encryption_configuration, leaving data science data stored at rest in cleartext.
